rationale: Recent misses were mostly new tail architectures. This keeps the best Bigram-64 projection-tail path intact and instead spends a small reserved slice on post-roundtrip calibration targeted only at the float-kept logit/bigram head, which is closest to the final exact int8+zlib score. The change is compile-stable, stays within the existing wallclock budget, removes the unused embed-calibration knob, and directly optimizes the parameters that survive quantization with the least distortion.
title: Roundtripped Bigram Tail Calibration
